method: Read-only current-source and retained-report inspection; no tests, inference, compilation, performance run, or source/packaging-script mutation.
current_candidate_full_qualification: pending_root_run2; no completed b917 qualification claimed

supported.claim: Snapshot-bound v2 local query selects one value-producing SSA instruction, allows only op/args/attrs changes, closes displayed operands and transitive SSA consumers, and includes complete reachable successor regions for value-affected branches, including no-result stores/drops. Downstream cycles use a bounded monotone fixed point.

Atomic batch accepts 1..16 nonoverlapping instruction sites on one immutable input; all changes are applied together and the entire resulting module is checked by the existing Core authority. Stale/altered queries, duplicate site identities, inconsistent shared render context and response overreach reject.
First integrated run executed 53 Agent-query mechanism tests with zero failures/errors/skips. This is mechanical API evidence, not a model trial.

limits.batch_budget_note: The 256-operation/64-block budgets apply to each constituent query; batch-wide wire budget is 1 MiB, not an aggregate 256-operation guarantee.
unclosed: A backedge reaching the selected block rejects and requires a full-module view.
The slice is conservative reachability, not a precise control-dependence or memory-alias proof.
The local selector requires an SSA output; no-result operations are visible context but cannot directly be selected through this API.
Callees are represented by signatures/effects, not a proved whole-program interprocedural behavioral slice.
Whole-module type/resource verification does not establish intended functional equivalence, external caller migration safety, or general Agent productivity.
Atomic admission is a verifier transaction; verified result is returned unpublished. Separate publication supports a new destination, not arbitrary multi-file filesystem rollback.

real_model_evidence.design: Four disclosed two-site arithmetic maintenance tasks x four HIA/Rust full/query arms x two model families; 32 task requests plus four preflights. Frozen plan, identified model/runtime bytes, greedy seed 0, 512 output tokens, one attempt, no correction/retry/rescoring; all actual completion usage retained.
real_model_evidence.unclosed: Historical real trials exist and must not be called fixtures; neither model met the predeclared success/token criterion. They do not qualify the changed b917 query/context implementation. Tasks are reused arithmetic compositions; representation and context vary together; human labor, integration/upstream maintenance, model setup/training, independent task populations and total economic cost are unmeasured.

supported.claim: Real standalone Linux x86-64 samples compare direct LLVM with same-input checked Rust and independent handwritten safe Rust. Fixed protocol: seven paired groups, all 63 samples retained, no clipping/retries/calibration, kernel ratio <=1.20, geometric mean <=1.10, relative MAD <=0.05.

First run: ratio thresholds had no failures, but constructor_error/llvm relative MAD=0.08300516377483902 and two_stage/llvm=0.07620544908304734 exceeded 0.05. Status measurement_inconclusive; host_performance_gate_passed=false.

Application gate passed its evidence/correctness protocol with three trials, 96 requests per trial and 16 warmups; raw report retains 40 slower metric comparisons. Sequential instrumented in-process C ABI calls include allocation, processing, cleanup and instrumentation, with percentile/RSS/allocation observations.
Core input ceilings and interpreter budgets are explicit, and resource/failure-cleanup paths and selected QEMU targets executed in run1.

unclosed: No universal Rust performance superiority, whole-language performance qualification or broad architecture-independent non-regression conclusion.

Application RPS is request_count/summed timed ABI intervals, not wall-clock network service throughput. No external service SLO, asynchronous queue-tail latency, multi-machine result or uninstrumented production latency.

Tracked payload/live-byte budgets do not bound allocator overhead, VM/interpreter memory, whole-process RSS or arbitrary native/foreign resources. Core JSON ceilings are 8 MiB, 262144 nodes and depth 64; they are admission limits, not a process-memory proof.

Cortex-M4 result is pinned QEMU system-model execution with trusted Rust BSP/startup/MMIO obligations; no physical board/device timing, DMA, GPU or interrupt-resource soundness qualification. AArch64/RV64 emulation does not close those physical requirements.

supported.claim: Selected actual verified HIA is exported instruction-by-instruction into independent Lean register semantics. Accepted profile: one straight-line function, two u32 inputs, one u32 return, no effects, 1..128 const/wrapping-add/wrapping-sub operations. Fixed external specification is x+y modulo 2^32, not copied from the exported instruction stream.

Run1 Lean kernel passed run_append and selected_program_correct for all 2^64 input pairs; positive source, instruction map, model/exporter/checker source hashes, pinned executable and support files are bound. Two changed-program controls reject against the unchanged specification; optional native differential actually passed 272 cases.
Separate run1 abstract formal-core and memory/type models passed actual Lean checks: 11 core theorems with two negative mutations; 19 provenance/type theorems with five negative mutations.

unclosed: No machine-checked correspondence/refinement proof from Python exporter/verifier, ownership checker or resource IR to Lean semantics. Hash binding is identity evidence, not such a proof.
Selected all-input theorem excludes resources, borrowing, cancellation, CFG loops, FFI and concurrency; 272 native cases do not prove LLVM/native backend refinement.

Abstract provenance assumes supplied allocation facts, identity/generation and pairwise compatibility; it does not prove allocation creation/global freshness/unforgeability, machine address reuse, all-loan liveness or the production type system.
Lean kernel, runtime/imported libraries and host remain trusted. Whole-compiler soundness, all unsafe/foreign boundaries and hardware correctness remain unproved.

run1_failures: standalone_performance: fixed MAD quality limit exceeded
publication_and_source_identity.source_rule: An evidence-publishing/entry-fixing descendant does not inherit a completed qualification. b917 run2 is still active; retained a4 and 5818 reports keep their original source identities. Entry-point targeted checks do not replace an integrated run.
publication_and_source_identity.artifact_rule: Archive preserves producer-retained files and records missing temporaries; native_binaries_retained=false remains false. Byte inventories and packaging verification establish retained bytes, not new native execution or proof.

conclusion: P5 mechanism substantially implemented and mechanically checked; P6 finite execution/measurement and P7 selected/abstract proofs exist. Strict P5/P6/P7 closure and the overall seven-stage claims remain false.
